observations.summary: O_EXCL (the new-file-only guarantee) is unpinned: without it (F2) an existing 0644 file is opened, chmodded to 0600 and accepted as Ok(Entries(1)), unnoticed by owner tests. Add an existing-name test (AlreadyExists; content and mode untouched). Before any caller.

RetainedDirectory::create_exclusive_regular has no platform test; its name refusals are masked by the security pre-check (F6) and its O_EXCL/mode behaviour is only exercised through the caller. Add a platform unit test (bad names InvalidInput, existing AlreadyExists, final symlink not followed, mode 0600).
Carried r2 O2: the umask fix is pinned only by reviewer evidence (F3 survives at the normal umask; probe under umask 0277 yields 600).

Carried: a refusal after creation (or an fchmod failure inside create_exclusive_regular, not mentioned in its doc) leaves the entry and retries fail AlreadyExists; with a retained parent, unlinkat(dirfd, name) after an fstatat identity check is now feasible.

create_exclusive_regular is a public unaccounted native write, consistent with RetainedDirectory's other mutation methods; its only caller charges first. A charged wrapper would prevent uncharged creation by future callers.
openat mode argument is a bare 0o600; the existing staging call uses 0o600 as libc::c_uint (identical bits). Carried r3 O1: unused From impls and nested WorkFailure in Capture/Append.
